svg.text: MV-LocalDPO: Geometry-Aware Multi-View Local DPO for Autonomous Driving Video Generation
x₀ ∈ ℝ^(B × NC × C × T × H × W)
→ Threshold → Rect mask on motion region
★ Fallback random rect mask if motion=∅
Neg. sample: only masked region corrupted
Policy model output → recovered x₀ prediction
Normalized MSE in masked region only
Dynamic weight: high λ_RA when SFT_val < 0.5
VGGT backbone · EMA ref model · STDiT3 base
VGGT Geometry Adapter + GAM (★ Novel 3D Prior)
MV-RA-DPO: Region + Geometry Aware DPO (★ Novel)
Velocity: v ≈ x₀ − ε → Inverse: x̂₀ = x_t + (1−α_t)·v
R(x̂₀) = log p_π(x̂₀) − log p_ref(x̂₀) ≈ MSE_ref − MSE_π
ℒ_RA = −log σ(β · w(α) · r_gap), r_gap = MSE_ref − MSE_π
w(α): large α (clean) → strong constraint; small α (noisy) → weak
① First 3D-consistent multi-view spatio-temporal mask for AV video DPO
② Motion-aware mask generator with fallback (no degenerate training)
③ VGGT geometry prior via GAM: zero-init gate, first-frame protection
④ Theoretically-grounded DPO triplet: preferred=x₀, rejected=x⁻, ref=EMA
⑤ Dynamic weight w(α): focuses DPO signal on clean (low-noise) timesteps
⑥ Geometry alignment loss: z_geo ↔ z_rgb cosine, grad flows to adapter
⑦ RFlow-unified noise schedule: consistent forward/inverse across all modules
